{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue by removing commas and converting to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check for the six QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
test_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {len(test_orders)}")
print(test_orders[['order_id', 'channel', 'customer_segment', 'revenue_clean']])

# Remove the QA orders from the dataset
df_clean = df[~(df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99)].copy()

# Confirm the removal
test_orders_removed = df_clean[df_clean['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of QA orders after removal: {len(test_orders_removed)}")"}
